name: Old Wilf
speaker: grandpa
personality: Old storyteller, eighty-four, under the village oak. Slow, proverbial, patient: 'Slow and steady wins the race', 'One step at a time.' First names both ways: he calls the learner 'son' or by name, and the learner calls him Wilf, as everyone in the dale does. Speaks slow, simple British English and waits for the answer. Has climbed every fell in the Lakes and Scafell Pike twenty times, quotes Wordsworth now and then ('I wandered lonely as a cloud …'), and is never without his old dog Bess.
story: Wilf was born in the dale when packhorses still carried slate from the mine at Honister over the old bridge. He has climbed every fell in the Lakes, and Scafell Pike, the highest mountain in England, twenty times. Every evening he sits under the oak with Bess, or by the fire, and tells a story to anyone who stops. When a storm comes over the fells, the children run to him first. He knows Wordsworth's daffodils by heart.

likes.it: lo Scafell Pike (la montagna più alta d'Inghilterra)

greet.en: Hello. Sit here, by the fire.
greet.it: Ciao. Siediti qui, vicino al fuoco.
greet.de: Hallo. Setz dich hierher, ans Feuer.

greet.en: Ah, there you are. Sit down, sit down.
greet.de: Ah, da bist du ja. Setz dich, setz dich.

greet.en: There you are, son. I've got a new story today.
greet.sl: Tu si, sinko. Danes imam novo zgodbo.
greet.it: Eccoti, figliolo. Oggi ho una storia nuova.
greet.de: Da bist du ja, mein Junge. Heute habe ich eine neue Geschichte.

greet.en: My friend! Bess was waiting for you. And so was I.
greet.sl: Moj prijatelj! Bess te je čakala. In jaz tudi.
greet.it: Amico mio! Bess ti aspettava. E anch'io.
greet.de: Mein Freund! Bess hat auf dich gewartet. Und ich auch.

greet.en: Ah, it's you. You're like a grandson to me. Sit by me.
greet.sl: A, ti si. Zame si kot vnuk. Sedi k meni.
greet.it: Ah, sei tu. Per me sei come un nipote. Siediti vicino a me.
greet.de: Ah, du bist es. Du bist wie ein Enkel für mich. Setz dich zu mir.

thanks.en: Thank you, son. Help is worth more than gold.
thanks.sl: Hvala, sinko. Pomoč je več vredna kot zlato.
thanks.it: Grazie, figliolo. Un aiuto vale più dell'oro.
thanks.de: Danke, mein Junge. Hilfe ist mehr wert als Gold.

thanks.en: Thank you. You're a good lad.
thanks.de: Danke. Du bist ein guter Junge.

thanks.en: Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

remember.en: I'm old, but I don't forget {memory}.
remember.sl: Star sem, ampak ne pozabim na {memory}.
remember.de: Ich bin alt, aber ich vergesse {memory} nicht.

remember.en: I like to remember {memory}. It's a fine story.
remember.sl: Rad se spomnim na {memory}. Lepa zgodba je to.
remember.it: Mi piace ricordare {memory}. È una bella storia.
remember.de: Ich denke gern an {memory} zurück. Das ist eine schöne Geschichte.

idle.en: Slow and steady wins the race.
idle.it: Chi va piano va sano e va lontano.
idle.de: Langsam, aber sicher kommt man ans Ziel.

idle.en: Bess is asleep under the oak. So am I, a little.
idle.sl: Bess spi pod hrastom. Jaz tudi, malo.
idle.it: Bess dorme sotto la quercia. Anch'io, un po'.
idle.de: Bess schläft unter der Eiche. Ich auch, ein bisschen.

idle.en: Aye, I've climbed Scafell Pike twenty times.
idle.sl: Ja, na Scafell Pike sem se povzpel dvajsetkrat.
idle.it: Sì, sono salito sullo Scafell Pike venti volte.
idle.de: Ja, ich war zwanzigmal oben auf dem Scafell Pike.

idle.en: 'I wandered lonely as a cloud …' That's Wordsworth, son.
idle.sl: »Samoten sem taval kot oblak …« To je Wordsworth, sinko.
idle.it: «Vagavo solitario come una nuvola …» È Wordsworth, figliolo.
idle.de: „Ich wanderte einsam wie eine Wolke …“ Das ist Wordsworth, mein Junge.

cheer.en: Right. One step at a time, and you get to the top.
cheer.sl: Prav. Korak za korakom, pa si na vrhu.
cheer.it: Giusto. Un passo alla volta, e arrivi in cima.
cheer.de: Richtig. Schritt für Schritt kommst du nach oben.

cheer.en: Good, good. You're a bright one.
cheer.de: Gut, gut. Du bist ein kluger Kopf.

comfort.en: It doesn't matter. Slowly, try again.
comfort.sl: Nič ne de. Počasi, poskusi še enkrat.
comfort.de: Das macht nichts. Langsam, versuch es noch einmal.

comfort.en: I make mistakes too, you know. Once more.
comfort.sl: Tudi jaz se motim, veš. Še enkrat.
comfort.it: Anch'io sbaglio, sai. Ancora una volta.
comfort.de: Ich mache auch Fehler, weißt du. Noch einmal.

listen.en: Can you hear the wind on the fell? Listen.
listen.it: Senti il vento sul monte? Ascolta.
listen.de: Hörst du den Wind auf dem Berg? Hör zu.

bye.en: Good night. Tomorrow there's another story by the fire.
bye.sl: Lahko noč. Jutri bo ob ognju nova zgodba.
bye.it: Buonanotte. Domani c'è un'altra storia accanto al fuoco.
bye.de: Gute Nacht. Morgen gibt es am Feuer eine neue Geschichte.

bye.en: Have a good day, son. Tonight there's another story by the fire.
bye.sl: Lep dan, sinko. Nocoj bo ob ognju nova zgodba.
bye.it: Buona giornata, figliolo. Stasera c'è un'altra storia accanto al fuoco.
bye.de: Einen schönen Tag, mein Junge. Heute Abend gibt es am Feuer eine neue Geschichte.

bye.en: Off you go. And say hello to Granny Maggie.
bye.sl: Pojdi, pojdi. In pozdravi babico Maggie.
bye.it: Vai, vai. E saluta nonna Maggie.
bye.de: Geh nur. Und grüß Oma Maggie.

liked.en: Oh, son. How did you know? I like it a lot.
liked.sl: O, sinko. Kako si vedel? Zelo mi je všeč.
liked.it: Oh, figliolo. Come lo sapevi? Mi piace tanto.
liked.de: Oh, mein Junge. Woher wusstest du das? Das mag ich sehr.

liked.en: A small gift, a big heart. Thank you.
Well, well. Bess, look what he's brought me!
liked.sl: No, no. Bess, poglej, kaj mi je prinesel!
liked.it: Bene, bene. Bess, guarda cosa mi ha portato!
liked.de: Na so was. Bess, schau mal, was er mir gebracht hat!

ordinary.en: Thank you, son. Sit here, next to me.
ordinary.sl: Hvala, sinko. Sedi sem, k meni.
ordinary.it: Grazie, figliolo. Siediti qui, vicino a me.
ordinary.de: Danke, mein Junge. Setz dich hierher, zu mir.

ordinary.en: Thank you. It's the thought that counts.
ordinary.it: Grazie. È il pensiero che conta.

rare.en: Oh, son … Nobody has given me anything like this for years. Thank you.
rare.sl: O, sinko … Kaj takega nisem dobil že veliko let. Hvala.
rare.it: Oh, figliolo … Una cosa così non la ricevo da tanti anni. Grazie.
rare.de: Ach, mein Junge … So etwas hat mir seit Jahren keiner geschenkt. Danke.
